_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil statistics (5% chance of ±2pt moves, 0-for-18 on forced directional calls) demand statistical honesty — HOLD is the graded call until stablecoin growth reverses or funding spikes break the coil.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst says HOLD with medium conviction citing coil stats and divergent factors; narrative implies UP via bottoming analog but does not explicitly state forward direction
next_move.confirmed_if: stablecoin_growth rises above 45 AND btc_momentum_30d holds above 48
next_move.invalidated_if: funding spikes above 0.008% with btc_momentum_30d dropping below 42
